feature_order: per frame: [LEFT: 42 hand xy normalized, 8 anchor offsets xy (shoulder_mid, forehead, nose, chin), 1 presence] then [RIGHT: same], then the same 102 values again as frame-to-frame deltas (first frame = 0)
normalization: hand: subtract wrist (landmark 0), divide by max |landmark - wrist| in that frame. anchor offset: (wrist - anchor) / shoulder_width. a missing anchor falls back to the shoulder midpoint, then to 0. missing values -> 0.0, presence flag -> 0.0
resampling: np.linspace(0, n_frames-1, T).round() index sampling, then deltas
